page_title: HAM 1-1 EIN | Hamburger SV v Eintracht Frankfurt 20/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
90+6' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) commits a foul during an attacking move.
90+3' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle and it's Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
89' The ball is cleared after Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
89' Eintracht Frankfurt take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
89' 42:58 – the latest ball possession ratio.
88' Rayan Philippe goes off the pitch and Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) comes on.
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ransford Konigsdorffer walks off the pitch to be replaced by Immanuel Pherai (Hamburger).
86' The attendance for today's match is 56100.
84' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Elias Baum.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) is coming onto the pitch as Ansgar Knauff cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' The goal by Hamburger SV won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
81' Wait! Referee Tobias Stieler has indicated he is going to review the Hamburger SV goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
80' It's 2:1! Ransford Konigsdorffer feeds Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
80' Eintracht Frankfurt enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

77' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
76' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Eintracht Frankfurt.

74' Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.
74' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.

73' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
73' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) will deliver the corner kick.
72' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger). The referee blows his whistle, Hamburger SV are awarded a corner kick.
71' The substitution has been made. Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) has replaced Hugo Larsson.
71' The referee allows time for a substitution. Rasmus Kristensen will be replaced by Elias Baum (Eintracht Frankfurt).
70' Merlin Polzin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) replacing Fabio Balde.
69' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul and Tobias Stieler immediately signals a free kick.
68' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
65' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
64' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Daniel Heuer Fernandes comes off his line to intercept.
61' Merlin Polzin decides to make a substitution. Daniel Elfadli will be replaced by Aboubaka Soumahoro (Hamburger).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) replaces William Mikelbrencis.

59' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the right side of the goal, but he can't get the power to direct it past Daniel Heuer Fernandes, who keeps it out.
59' The ball is out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt manage to earn a corner.
56' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a chip pass into the box, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes is quickest to intercept the ball.
53' Eintracht Frankfurt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

53' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
51' Eintracht Frankfurt are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
48' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hamburger SV comes to nothing.
46' The second half has just started.
46' Dino Toppmoller makes a half-time substitution. Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on in place of Jean-Matteo Bahoya.
45+4' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) rises high to head a nice lofted cross low towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Michael Zetterer makes a comfortable save.
41' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball has crossed the sideline. Hamburger SV are taking a throw-in.
39' Total attempts – 6:1.
36' Hamburger SV seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

34' Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Tobias Stieler with no other option than to blow for a foul.

31' That's unlucky! Miro Muheim (Hamburger) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
29' Hamburger SV failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
27' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only crashes against the crossbar.

26' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Nathaniel Brown plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
26' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging some short passes.
25' An attempted cross from Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared. The linesman signals a throw-in for Eintracht Frankfurt.
23' Neat link-up play between Fabio Balde (Hamburger) and Ransford Konigsdorffer, but Michael Zetterer reads the game well and the move breaks down.
21' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
19' 1 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:0.
18' William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger) attempts to find Nicolas Capaldo, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

16' Eintracht Frankfurt are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
14' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hamburger SV.

13' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
10' Hamburger SV are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
7' The corner from Fabio Balde (Hamburger) is cleared away by the defence.

7' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. The ball goes behind for a corner. Hamburger SV will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Eintracht Frankfurt.
4' Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
2' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Eintracht Frankfurt will have the kick-off.
Tobias Stieler is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
